_comment: Corner markers of the 1.5 m x 1.5 m demo space, flat on the floor, world metres, as ACTUALLY laid out. ONLY IDs 1, 3, 5, 7 are used. ID 1 = origin; ID 7 = along +x; ID 5 = along +y; ID 3 = opposite corner (diagonal 1-3 = 2.12 m). x/y are marker CENTRES (measure). yaw_deg = sheet rotation, measured automatically by calib/extrinsics.py when a camera sees all 4; it's only used by cameras that see 1-3 markers.
